rows.continue_if: Public root and v2-preview dashboard HTML/JSON are fresh, matching, and show operator attention, notification state, n8n budget, market clock, and first command.
rows.stop_if: Public dashboard is stale, unreachable, missing operator evidence, or notification state is inconsistent.
rows.note: Public cockpit command must pass before deeper checks; current notification channel=dashboard_only

rows.name: standby_packet
rows.continue_if: Status is PASS/WATCH and next_action is continue_bounded_observation.
rows.stop_if: Status is FAIL, live IBKR port is open, approval boundary fails, or next_action is unclear.
rows.note: Run the execution-mode gate first; if it says continue, prove the public dashboard cockpit before standby.

rows.name: bounded_observation
rows.stop_if: Any hard failure, accounting drift, stale dashboard data, or unexpected workflow/broker/X mutation.
rows.note: Use bash foundation_v2/run_v2_monday_safe_observation.sh for bounded observation only.

rows.name: publish_dashboard
rows.continue_if: Publisher exits cleanly, all dashboard JSON locations sync, and public dashboard data remains fresh.
rows.stop_if: Publisher fails, JSON keys are missing, dashboard data is stale, or public/root/v2-preview artifacts diverge.
rows.note: Latest publisher run status=success key_count=54 copied_dashboard=True copied_tmp=True recent_success=True

rows.name: monday_live_proof_check
rows.continue_if: Proof status is WAITING, WATCH, or PASS with no hard failures and safety flags clean.
rows.stop_if: Proof status is FAIL, count math breaks, safety flags change, or hard failures appear.
rows.note: Continue bounded observation; do not expand or mirror until all proof gates are clean.

rows.name: ibkr_paper_preflight
rows.continue_if: Paper port 4002 or 7497 is open, account DUQ523641 is confirmed, and live ports 4001/7496 are closed.
rows.stop_if: Any live port is open, paper account is not DUQ523641, or paper connection fails.
rows.note: No IBKR Gateway/TWS process or paper API port detected. Open IBKR Gateway/TWS paper, enable API socket, use paper port 4002 or 7497, then rerun this preflight.

rows.name: stock_expansion_preflight_bundle
rows.continue_if: Bundle reports fixture_suite=PASS, hard_failures=[], stock_expansion_allowed=false unless every gate and exact approval are present.
rows.stop_if: Any hard failure, failed contract check, broker-order allowance, live-port issue, or expansion allowed without an exact approved packet. Contract: python3 foundation_v2/v2_stock_expansion_preflight_bundle_check.py --execute

rows.name: current_day_candidate
rows.continue_if: A current-day candidate is eligible and the packet still reports broker_order=not placed.
rows.stop_if: No eligible candidate exists, candidate is stale, or any protected-surface check fails.
rows.note: review the dry-run command; paper order still requires exact user approval

rows.name: paper_order_approval_packet
rows.approval_required: I approve one IBKR paper mirror test on DUQ523641 only.
rows.continue_if: User provides the exact paper approval phrase in this primary chat.
rows.stop_if: Approval phrase is absent, approximate, scoped to more than one trade, or mentions live brokerage.
rows.note: No paper order is approved; continue observation until one current-day candidate is eligible.

rows.name: mirror_sql_review_packet
rows.approval_required: I approve applying the IBKR paper mirror SQL for trade [id] only.
rows.continue_if: User provides the separate exact mirror SQL approval phrase for that one trade.
rows.stop_if: Paper fill evidence is missing or the user has not approved the mirror SQL separately.
rows.note: Mirror SQL requires a proven paper fill and separate exact SQL approval.

rows.name: scheduler_status_check
rows.approval_required: I approve installing the Monday safe observation scheduler only.
rows.continue_if: activation_allowed=false unless the exact scheduler approval phrase is present.
rows.stop_if: Any scheduler is installed/loaded unexpectedly or approval text is not exact.
rows.note: Scheduler remains ready-not-installed unless exact approval is present.
